recommendation: Keep the commit as the FHIR-47627 source fix. Any broader cleanup of other future-release roadmap text should be handled by a separate tracker because it was outside the final FMG motion for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-47627 was an Applied FHIR-core change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that the Version Management Policy stop presenting an outdated release cadence. The final resolution was to remove references to frequency of publication from the description of versioning.
initial_application: Git commit 2f9d5a3ad195110195605fee188a9d2d7506c3e7 partially applied the issue by replacing the explicit 18-24 month cadence with ongoing-basis wording and clarifying "Each new release of FHIR", but it retained time-between-publications, release-cycle, and limited-scope shorter-timeline text.
additional_context: FHIR-I initially supported making the paragraph informative and adding a Confluence link if FMG maintained one, but FMG's final 2025-04-02 minutes narrowed the approved action to removing frequency references from the noted paragraph. Quoted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Deleted the opening paragraph under source/versions.html#versions because every sentence in that paragraph described publication timing/cadence or justified the release cycle. The remaining semantic-versioning and development-branch description was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/versions.html: removed the first paragraph under the FHIR Releases and Versioning anchor that still described publication timing, release-cycle rationale, and shorter limited-scope release timing.
